description: This file defines the EmailConfig class, which encapsulates email configuration properties such as host, port, protocol, username, password, and SMTP settings. It includes methods for converting the configuration to JSON format and getters/setters for each property.

classes.name: EmailConfig
classes.description: A class representing the configuration settings required for sending emails, including server details and authentication options.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts the EmailConfig object to its JSON string representation, including host, port, protocol, username, password, smtpAuth, and starttls flags.

methods.name: isSmtpAuth
methods.description: Returns whether SMTP authentication is enabled.

methods.name: setSmtpAuth
methods.description: Sets whether SMTP authentication is enabled.

methods.name: setEmailTemplatesPath
methods.description: Sets the path to email templates.

methods.name: getEmailTemplatesPath
methods.description: Gets the path to email templates.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol used for email communication.

methods.name: setProtocol
methods.description: Sets the protocol used for email communication.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username for email server authentication.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for email server authentication.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password for email server authentication.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for email server authentication.
